ModMetaData.name: Zakkeg Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Zakkeg art (south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 sitting ruling: art redo directed "lean, boney, and deeply disturbing" for this SW canon creature, never a rename. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Zakkeg/Zakkeg_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
VERIFIED 2026-09-11 (ART_REGEN_WAVE1_WIRE_IN_1): confirmed live via a bridge quicktest spawn + screenshot that this mod's loose PNG wins the same-path resolution over the donor's AssetBundle-packed texture by load order - same mechanism as MynockArtOverride, now proven for this donor on RimWorld 1.6.4871.
